hook: Text-based video editing is the biggest leap in creator tooling since digital audio.

hook_variants.text: Text-based video editing is the biggest leap in creator tooling since digital audio.
Why scrubbing video waveforms will feel prehistoric by next year.

hook_chosen_reason: Strong technology evolution angle drawing an analogy to major industry shifts.
caption:
Imagine having to edit text by listening to millisecond audio frequencies.
That is how video editing has worked for 30 years.

Deleting text to cut video is how software should have worked from day one.

#CreatorTools #VideoTech #IncuBrix #BuildInPublic
cta: Try text-based video cuts at www.incubrix.com
tools_used: IncuBrix Python Content Engine v1.0, Pillow, imageio-ffmpeg
